GenAiFunction.description: Use this when the customer wants to compare plans, see pricing options, upgrade or downgrade, or switch to a different plan or package — for example mobile, internet, TV, or streaming tiers. Shows a stack of plan cards with monthly price, a feature checklist, a recommended highlight, and the customer's current plan marked; the customer picks one to switch to.
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: ASA Technology, Media & Comms · Plan Comparison
